title: Inclusive Thinking
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that embracing complexity and holding opposites can lead to a more inclusive and flexible mind. By accepting both sides of an issue, rather than trying to simplify or categorize it, we can cultivate a mindset that can navigate challenges with kindness and hope. This approach encourages us to look beyond black-and-white thinking and instead find a middle ground where both good and bad coexist, allowing us to respond to reality as it is, without judgment or simplification.
